inputs.problem: In today's fast-paced world, mental health issues are on the rise, yet access to personalized support remains limited. We need a platform that leverages AI to provide tailored mental health resources and support based on individual user profiles and needs. This platform will analyze user inputs, such as mood, stress levels, and personal circumstances, to offer customized coping strategies, mindfulness exercises, and access to professional help when necessary. By integrating this technology into the healthcare & insurance sector, we can enhance the mental well-being of users while reducing the stigma associated with seeking help. This solution is timely as mental health awareness is growing, and the demand for accessible support is higher than ever.
